name: Galaxy Watch 9

images.credit: Kyu3a, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Predecessor: Samsung Galaxy Watch 8, Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra

Body.Dimensions: Watch 9 (40 mm): 42.7 x 40.4 x 8.6 mm, Watch 9 (44 mm): 46.0 x 43.7 x 8.6 mm, Watch Ultra 2: 47.4 x 47.1 x 10.7 mm
Body.Weight: 31.5 g (40 mm), 34 g (44 mm), 61.5 g (Ultra 2, without strap)

Platform.Operating system: Wear OS 7.0 with One UI 9 Watch
Platform.Chipset: Qualcomm Snapdragon Wear Elite (SDW6100, penta-core, 3 nm)

Display.Display: Watch 9: Super AMOLED, 1.34 in 438×438 (40 mm),1.47 in 480×480 (44 mm), up to 3,000 nits, Watch Ultra 2: Super AMOLED, 1.52 in (38.5 mm) 498×498, up to 5,000 nits, Sapphire crystal

Battery.Charging: Qi-based wireless charging, Watch Ultra 2: high-frequency fast charging, up to 40% in about 30 minutes

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 6.0, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz, NFC, GPS (L1+L5 dual-frequency)
